description.value:
Duration constant

See through invisibility and possession affecting spirits and ghost-machines at will, no action required.

You automatically perceive the true form and true location of any spirit or ghost-machine within your line of sight, through invisibility, illusion, or possession, with no action and no check. A possessed creature reads to you as two things at once, and you know which is which. This does not extend to creatures that are neither spirits nor ghost-machines.
